panels.blockingAndAction: At the opening, all three boys hold classic shooters over an EMPTY bowl, one stationary palm-sized Beyblade level and flush beneath each shooter, firmly twist-locked on both fully inserted posts, tips down, rigid toothed winders fully inserted. They hold during the countdown. At 5.8 seconds each pulling hand snaps its winder straight outward once while the shooter hand stays stable. The teeth drive the internal gears. Nanao’s blue-red-yellow Beyblade and Mocha’s white-red-purple Beyblade receive spin and release downward immediately. Kaiden’s firmly seated handmade blue-red-metal-and-brown-wood Beyblade receives gear torque, but only at the release event one launcher opening catches on the deformed washer edge and the two posts disengage asynchronously. The top loses usable axial alignment and drops sideways. It was level and securely locked on both posts before the pull; the failure occurs only during unlock and release. Fully extracted winders remain in the pulling hands and all shooter undersides are empty after release.
panels.spatialBlocking: THREE-PLAYER ARENA GEOGRAPHY: the complete stadium is centered between all three boys, not offset in front of or behind the group. Kaiden holds the south position, Nanao the north-west position and Mocha the north-east position around the rim; preserve those screen relationships across cuts.

The extracted ripcord is fully separate in the pulling hand; no string, tether, duplicate top or delayed spin-up.
